movement_profile.footwork: Stylized footwork accentuated by leg rattles

music_profile.sound_description: A polyrhythmic soundscape driven by the call-and-response of two drums, layered with the percussive sound of leg rattles and rhythmic hand-clapping.

basic_steps: Rhythmic footwork synchronized with the Shauro and Tsinhiro drums.
Integration of leg rattles to emphasize the beat.
Participation in makwa (hand-clapping) to maintain the polyrhythmic structure.
teaching.rhythm: Triple meter with a specific pattern: '1, 2 … 1, 2, 3, 4 … 1, 2, 3'.
